messages:
tayla_customer: Hi, trying to redeem promo 'REDWOOD-GRANT-50' via the API and getting `promo_invalid_or_expired`. Dashboard shows the promo active until 2026-12-31. Can you help?

emma_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the curl you used and the response body + X-Correlation-ID?

tayla_customer: Sure, here’s the curl and the response:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"code":"REDWOOD-GRANT-50","email":"tayla@example.com"}'
```
Response (400):
```json
{"error":"promo_invalid_or_expired","message":"This promo code is invalid or expired","correlation_id":"c2f9a7b4-8e4a-4c3a-b2d9-11a2c3d4e5f6"}
```

emma_support: Thanks — forwarding to infra with correlation_id c2f9a7b4... and the API path. I’ll ping once we know more.

promo-bot: Noted: ticket #SUP-1248 created for correlation_id c2f9a7b4-8e4a-4c3a-b2d9-11a2c3d4e5f6

nick_eng: Looking at the logs for that correlation_id. Got the redeem request, promo lookup returned an expiry value of `1700000000000` and code was rejected because server compared `valid_until < now_seconds`.

emma_support: huh that `1700000000000` looks huge — milliseconds?

nick_eng: Exactly. We recently ran a promo-migration that moved legacy promos into the new store. Most promos were written in seconds, but a subset (partner grants created on 2024-11-02) were persisted with epoch milliseconds due to a bug in the migration script. The runtime expects seconds (int ~1e9) and treats numbers >1e12 as already expired when cast/truncated.

jen_ops: Confirmed in the DB: promo id 4421 (REDWOOD-GRANT-50) row has valid_until=1700000000000. Current epoch seconds is ~1967... so comparison fails.

emma_support: Is this customer-facing intermittently or only for that promo?

nick_eng: Only promos ingested in that migration window. Few dozen affected. We'll push a hotfix to redemption service to normalize >1e12 values by dividing by 1000 before comparing. Also adding a safety check + migration script to fix DB rows.

jen_ops: ETA for hotfix?

nick_eng: Can do a canary deploy in 20m to staging, then prod hotfix in ~45m. Patch is tiny:
```python
# redemption check snippet
if valid_until > 1_000_000_000_000:
    valid_until = valid_until // 1000
if valid_until < int(time.time()):
    raise PromoExpiredError()
```

emma_support: Great. Meanwhile we should offer Tayla a manual credit so their flow isn't blocked. Tayla — we can grant a one-time 50-credit trial while we fix the backend, or reissue a new code. Which do you prefer?

tayla_customer: A one-time credit would be great, thanks. Also would appreciate a notification when original code is fixed so I can reuse it for my team.

emma_support: Will do. I'm issuing a manual +50 credit now and creating a temporary promo code you can share with your team.

promo-bot: Manual credit +50 applied to tayla@example.com by emma_support (txn id tx_9f8e7d). Temporary code `RW-TEMP-50-TAYLA` generated; expires in 7 days.

nick_eng: Hotfix deployed to prod at 1967890400, running DB patch to normalize the stored values. Patch also emits metrics for how many >1e12 values we see so we can audit.

emma_support: Can you confirm Tayla's original `REDWOOD-GRANT-50` now redeems?

tayla_customer: Re-tested just now via the same curl — success! Response: 200 and promo applied. Thank you!! :heart:

emma_support: Awesome — sorry for the friction. We'll follow up with a short postmortem and the migration fix details.

nick_eng: Logged follow-up: GH issue #infra/1256 for migration cleanup + unit tests so ms/seconds mismatch can't happen again. :thumbsup:

jen_ops: Closing ticket SUP-1248 after confirm.

emma_support: Tayla, I'll DM you the temporary code and the manual credit txn for your records. If anything else pops up, ping us here or at support@redwood.ai.

tayla_customer: Got it — thanks everyone!
